5.7 Oil Storage Facilities
A sample quideline for precautionary measures to be taken before demolition of a fuel oil tank and underground
ail interceptor Is shown below:

A. Chemical waste shall be cleaned up prior to demolition and all oil storage facilities shall be thoroughly cleaned,
Tests should be carried out by specialist agents to ascertain the presence of any accumulated gases which
should be extracted and removed, The management of waste and waste water generated from the process must
conform to the Waste Disposal Ordinance and the Water Pollution Control Ordinance. The management of any
waste which is classifiable as a chemical waste shall be in accordance with the Waste Disposal (Chemical Waster)
(General) Requiation. In the case where a license for dangerous goods storage has been previously issued, the
licensee should cancel the DG License with the licensing authority, i.e, Fire Services Department, Any risk of
fire explosion and exposure to toxicity shall be minimized and confirmed by tests, For works under the category
of “ELA Designated Project’, they shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations in ElA Report.
